ycy zip
Zip a directory into a zip file
Usage:
  ycy zip [directory] [flags]
Flags:
  -h, --help	help for zip
  -d, --with-dir	Include the directory name as a top-level folder in the zip
  -w, --without-open	Do not open the zip file after creation
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
